title: 422 POOL_NOT_ACTIVE — only one Central Bank has seeded the pool
description: A corridor whose pair is confirmed but whose pool is still PENDING_COUNTERPART cannot trade. GET /api/v2/amm/pool/{pair}/status would have shown this before the swap was attempted.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway, spoke-crc. Verified in the delivered gateway (mapSwapExecError, domain.ErrCodePoolNotActive): exactly this error, error_code and recommended_action. This is why mock-amm-hp-04 belongs in the flow — the pool check is a precondition a client owns, not something the swap will do politely on its behalf. A pair id is used here that a client would have taken verbatim from listPairs; it is a genuinely different corridor, not a malformed identifier.

body.recommended_action: Wait for central banks to provision liquidity
